text.text: Population triples: 11,453 to 29,522. Landfill and reef mining for construction strip the island’s defences.
Malé’s history, from before 1153 to 2026. Compiled by the Malé group from Wikipedia.
Reclamation of Hulhumalé begins on 16 October. Malé’s growth moves to a new island.
Seawalls close all four coasts after the 1987 swell. Concrete replaces mined reef.
212,138 people in Malé City. The Thilamalé bridge opens, linking Malé to Hulhumalé and Villimalé.
